offering_description.value: Operates marine-life theme parks, other amusement parks, and water parks for families, tourists, and groups. It delivers rides, live shows, animal encounters, dining, and shopping at its parks and licenses its marine park brand for use in Abu Dhabi.

primary_products.value: Prepared food and beverages; souvenirs and apparel

primary_services.value: Theme and water park admission; live entertainment; guided animal encounters; group events

customer_segment.value: B2C: Families, tourists, local visitors, and passholders; B2B: Corporate groups, tour operators, and an overseas theme park developer

end_markets.value: Family leisure and recreation; travel and tourism; group outings and events

revenue_model.value: service fees: Park admission, premium ride access, animal encounters, and group events; product sales: Food, beverages, souvenirs, and apparel purchased at parks; subscription: Recurring park memberships at select parks; licensing or royalties: Use of marine park branding and intellectual property in Abu Dhabi
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; subscription; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Runs park facilities, rides, and animal habitats and sells admission to visitors and groups; retailer: Stocks merchandise and sells it to park visitors through on-site shops; other: Licenses its marine park brand and intellectual property to an overseas park developer

geography_served.value: global: Operates parks in Florida, California, Texas, Virginia, and Pennsylvania and licenses its marine park brand in the United Arab Emirates

specialization.value: related lines: Marine-life theme parks, other amusement parks, water parks, and immersive animal experiences

distribution_channels.value: online: Park websites and mobile apps for tickets and passes; own locations: Park ticket offices, shops, and food outlets; partners / resellers: Travel agencies, tour operators, and third-party ticket sellers; direct sales: Park group sales teams serving organizations and event planners
distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: USDA licensing for animal exhibition, federal marine mammal protections, and state amusement ride safety rules
